desc: Ideation: offline interval-union per coordinate line; move order irrelevant for coverage existence.
Parse N M Sx Sy, the N houses, and M moves from stdin using Python ints.
Simulate moves to compute final (X,Y), recording horizontal moves as inclusive intervals on their y-line and vertical moves as inclusive intervals on their x-line.
Merge intervals per fixed coordinate line, handling inclusive endpoints and overlapping/touching intervals.
For each house, count it if binary search finds its varying coordinate inside a merged interval on either orientation; check each house once.
Output X Y C separated by spaces.
Verify samples and edge cases (large coordinates/overflow, endpoint houses, revisits, dual-orientation coverage); both public samples pass.
